name: Ciri
slug: Ciri is a half-elf rogue connected to the Great Eldarin Tree and keeper of Lith's keystone, using stealth and teleportation.
description: Ciri is a half-elf rogue who is connected to the Great Eldarin Tree and serves as the keeper of the Lith keystone. She is capable of using stealth and teleportation to conceal her presence and move unexpectedly. Ciri’s connection to Lith places her in a realm that culturally rejects magic despite containing supernatural phenomena, making her powers potentially strange or unsettling to its inhabitants. Her role as Lith’s protector may lead her to become part of the realm’s history and folklore, potentially remembered as a witch or other supernatural figure.

log.summary: Ciri initially participates from the shadows, using a disembodied voice and concealing her location, before teleporting beside Ben and then returning to the center of the dais. She joins Gerk’s group and becomes connected to the Great Eldarin Tree. Ciri chooses **Lith** as the realm she will protect and receives its keystone. Although Lith culturally rejects magic, it still experiences supernatural phenomena, including occasional incursions or gaps involving things from other worlds that have become the basis for cryptid legends. Ciri’s presence and magic may eventually cause Lith’s inhabitants to interpret her as a witch or other supernatural figure, potentially making her part of the realm’s history and folklore.
notes: Initially participates from the shadows using a disembodied voice and concealing her location.
Teleports beside Ben before returning to the center of the dais.
Joins Gerk's group and becomes connected to the Great Eldarin Tree.
Chooses Lith as the realm she will protect and receives its keystone.
Lith rejects magic culturally but still contains supernatural phenomena, and Ciri may become part of its history and folklore.
Her magic may cause Lith's inhabitants to interpret her as a witch or other supernatural figure.
Lith experiences occasional incursions or gaps involving things from other worlds, which become sources of cryptid legends.

log.summary: Ciri was separated from the other party members following a magical event and initially could not see or hear them. While searching for her “exit buddy,” she tested the surrounding space by moving and striking through the air, eventually making physical contact with Sylan despite being unable to perceive him visually. This confirmed that the unseen party members remained physically present and could still be encountered by touch, although Ciri did not hear the contact. Ciri’s experience established that the magical separation affected normal visual and auditory perception without preventing physical interaction.
notes: Ciri was not among the characters directly identified as the primary targets of the initial magical effect.
After the event, Ciri searches for her 'exit buddy' but cannot find them.
Ciri cannot see the other party members after the magical event.
Ciri tests whether another person is physically present by swinging her hand through the air.
Ciri eventually makes physical contact with Sylan despite being unable to see him, confirming that the separation does not prevent physical contact.
Ciri does not hear the contact she makes with Sylan.
Ciri attempted to locate nearby people by blindly striking the air.
Ciri successfully made physical contact with Sylan, confirming that unseen people can still be physically encountered.
Ciri can perceive certain physical interactions despite the party's inability to see one another normally.

log.summary: While Walker is away, Ciri handles mind-link communication more reliably than he does, though she notes such contact may fall out of range without a spell. She stays aboard the invisible, silent party boat as the spectral-door crisis unfolds, unable to see the invisible struggle around her. During Sylan's head count she hides behind the mast or a barrel before eventually being accounted for with the rest of the party.
notes: Uses mind-link communication better than Walker while he is away; mind chat may be out of range without a spell.
Remains on the invisible party boat watching the chaos without being able to see the invisible struggle.
Hides behind the mast or a barrel during the head count and is eventually accounted for.

log.summary: Ciri is already at the New Navel pub when the others arrive, too drunk to stealth, crouched in the corner behind a pile of mugs and convinced she is hidden. At breakfast her face is in the buns. She has a room in the tavern, spends the night there, and rejoins the others on the path up to the stronghold in the same clothes, carrying her boots. She goes south into the forest with Sylan, Gerk, and Ord, lies down trying to nap, then hides so Gerk can open a door to her without seeing where she goes. Her stealth roll is 7 on the die; one report gives 23 as the total and another says the 7 did not beat a 23. After the door misses her, she throws her voice to answer, stays in a tree and watches, then goes with Sylan to inspect the far end and returns through the portal, noticed as a shadow passing behind him.
notes: Already at the New Navel pub when the others arrive, drunk enough that she can no longer stealth: crouched in the corner behind a pile of mugs, convinced she is hidden. At breakfast her face is in the buns.

She has a room in the tavern, spends the night there, and rejoins the others on the path up to the stronghold in the same clothes, carrying her boots. She goes south into the forest with Sylan, Gerk, and Ord.

She lies down trying to nap, then hides in the forest so Gerk can open a door to her without seeing where she goes. Her stealth roll is 7 on the die. One report gives 23 as the total and another says the 7 did not beat a 23.

After the door misses her, she throws her voice to answer, then stays in a tree and watches. She later goes with Sylan to inspect the far end and returns through the portal, noticed as a shadow passing behind him.

log.summary: During doorway practice Ciri throws rocks at Gerk. At the tavern she says she has been with the group the whole time and has not traveled away. She does not know whether the royalty matter is sorted, and she says she is still royal. She calls herself a hell of a bar owner; Sylan thinks the bar is doing well despite his rare visits. She is believed to be carrying a ring or bracelet from the white dragon hoard that shoots starbursts which turn into fireballs. Nightfall and Starfall were both suggested as names, but the name is not confirmed. She is absent from the lantern trial and the forest scene, and the table establishes that she is completely gone from those beats.
notes: Throws rocks at Gerk during doorway practice.

At the tavern she says she has been with the group the whole time and has not traveled away. She says she does not know whether the royalty matter is sorted, and also that she is still royal. She calls herself a hell of a bar owner. Sylan thinks the bar is doing well despite his rare visits.
She is believed to be carrying a ring or bracelet from the white dragon hoard that shoots starbursts which turn into fireballs. Nightfall and Starfall were both suggested. The name is not confirmed.

log.summary: Ciri agrees that Walker’s fire-resistance claim should be tested and starts a tinderbox under his arm. She goes to Carlkin’s with Walker, Dana, and Ord. She cannot ride Dana’s broom, so Araden carries her on the flight.

log.summary: Ciri hung back warily while Ord investigated Moxie, keeping her distance at first. She then brought the scrap bucket over and fed Moxie herself.
notes: Hung back warily as Ord investigated Moxie, then brought the scrap bucket over to feed it.
